response.overview: After a deadly ambush orchestrated by a treacherous stepbrother leaves an Arizona ranch owner and his wife dead, their young daughter Beatrice vanishes without a trace amidst a wave of outlaw violence. Years later, a young woman named Edna Sherwood—whose own father was murdered by the same notorious gang—takes a teaching job at the ranch, sparking a romance with the loyal foreman and setting the stage for long-buried secrets to resurface.
response.title: Perils of the West
